2607.25560.title: Agent Skills Matter: Inferring Proprietary Skills from Execution Trajectories
2607.25560.paper_summary: Agent skills package reusable procedures that improve downstream performance. Their lightweight, portable form enables marketplace monetization and private deployment behind cloud-hosted agent interfaces, giving providers incentives to keep high-value skills proprietary. Yet hiding the artifacts does not conceal their behavioral effects, which remain observable in execution trajectories and form a behavioral side channel. We define this exposure as Skill Leakage: reconstructing proprietary skills from trajectories elicited by benign queries, without reference answers or success labels. We introduce SigLeak, a black-box framework that exploits recurring skill signatures in agent behavior. It constructs diverse, decision-rich diagnostic tasks, contrasts matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled trajectories, and iteratively refines a reconstructed skill from the isolated patterns. Across five scenarios, three model families, and three agent frameworks, SigLeak outperforms or matches three baselines in nearly every setting. It raises the success rate by 6.88 percentage points over the skill-disabled reference on average and achieves the highest overall SkillSim, our metric for coarse- and fine-grained semantic similarity. These results show that benign execution trajectories can expose proprietary procedural knowledge. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SigLeak-D1DB.
2607.25560.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能包可重用的程序可改善下游性能。它們輕巧、可攜帶的形式使市場化獲利和在雲端托管的代理介面後進行私有部署成為可能，從而給予提供者保持高價值技能專有的動機。然而，隱藏這些工件並不會掩蓋其行為效應，這些效應在執行軌跡中仍然可觀察，並形成行為側通道。我們將這種暴露定義為技能洩漏：從無害查詢引發的軌跡中重建專有技能，而不參考答案或成功標籤。我們介紹了SigLeak，一個利用代理行為中重複技能特徵的黑箱框架。它構建多樣化、決策豐富的診斷任務，對比匹配的技能啟用和技能禁用的軌跡，並從孤立模式中迭代精煉重建的技能。在五個場景、三個模型系列和三個代理框架中，SigLeak在幾乎每個設置中都超越或匹配了三個基準。它平均提高了相對於技能禁用參考的成功率6.88個百分點，並實現了我們的粗略和細粒度語義相似性度量SkillSim的最高整體得分。這些結果顯示，無害的執行軌跡可以暴露專有的程序知識。代碼可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SigLeak-D1DB 獲得。
